meta.title: Moving a draft technical round's end to before the pricing round's end does not break the server
gaps: The available tokens cannot express the RFQ end minus 60 seconds; the closest expressible value is the pricing round's current end. The vocabulary also has no rfpTradeId token for addressing the technical round directly.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer moves the technical round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later, with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_…”.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
